captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a triple-chainring road bicycle crankset with an integrated bottom bracket spindle and pedals. It features a central dark grey cylindrical bottom-bracket shell housing a spindle, two light grey metallic crank arms, and three nested, silver-colored chainrings on the drive side. At the ends of the crank arms, two black clipless pedal bodies are attached via revolute joints, allowing them to spin freely relative to the crank arms.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a triple-chainring road crankset. It should feature a central bottom-bracket shell, two light-grey metallic crank arms, three nested silver chainrings attached to the right crank spider, and two black clipless pedals that can spin freely on revolute joints at the ends of the crank arms.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed by first creating a central bottom-bracket shell using a Cylinder primitive. Next, a rotatable spindle is defined, to which the left and right crank arms are attached. The crank arms are modeled as extruded profiles with rounded ends and central slots. The three nested chainrings are created with saw-tooth outer profiles and bolted onto a five-arm spider on the right crank arm. Finally, two clipless pedals are modeled as rectangular boxes with side grooves, connected to the crank arms via revolute joint definitions to allow realistic pedaling rotation.
